# KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED

> Enterprise technology company building intelligent everyday applications, high-velocity full-stack software, and clinical queue infrastructure with 100% Day-1 source code ownership.

KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED was founded by Arjun Jayesh. Operating across India, China, and the GCC region, KINBO engineers production AI systems, healthcare technology, and enterprise platforms.

## Core Documentation

- [Home & Capabilities](https://kinbosoft.com): High-velocity engineering overview, architectural principles, and rate estimates
- [QueueZero Clinical Runtime](https://kinbosoft.com/products/queuezero): Clinical triage and automated OPD queue orchestration infrastructure
- [Products & Deployments](https://kinbosoft.com/products): Overview of flagship deployments including QueueZero, Glowup, and Relic
- [Showcase & Client Works](https://kinbosoft.com/works): Engineering case studies across mobile apps, web platforms, and ERPs
- [Founder Dossier](https://kinbosoft.com/founder): Background, research publications, and architecture dossier of Arjun Jayesh
- [Engineering Journal](https://kinbosoft.com/blog): Technical articles on distributed systems, deterministic schedulers, and edge infrastructure
